== Title ==
<span lang="ja">タトゥイーン：大砂原</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
'''Light''' — <span lang="ja"></span>

'''Dark''' — <span lang="ja">戦闘運命数を引くのに必要な能力値が６以上になる。</span>

== Lore ==
The card has no printed lore box.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Tatooine: Dune Sea]].

'''Lore''' — The card has no printed lore box.

'''Game text''' — Light Side. The printed Light Side game-text box is blank. Dark Side. The ability required to draw battle destiny becomes 6 or more.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Dark text says the ability needed to draw battle destiny becomes 6 or more, and omits for you and here. Light game-text box is blank.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-L-tatooinedunesea.gif|Original English face]], [[Tatooine: Dune Sea]].</ref>
